rules: Receipt history is append-only: state transitions append events and never rewrite prior events.
Every future executor must create a planned receipt before attempting a side effect.
Execution must not be recorded as verified until deterministic postconditions have been checked.
A failed action that required rollback or compensation must record a final compensated event after that recovery is verified.
A receipt records what happened; it is not permission to execute and does not replace capability policy or approval checks.
